reason: This PR alters instance plan cache cloning behavior across multiple core planner plan types plus the clone generator/generated code. Although positioned as a performance change, shallow-copy adjustments in cached plan structures are high risk for planner/runtime correctness: they can leak mutable state across executions or sessions, break rebuild behavior, or create concurrency bugs. The touched files and added concurrency/rebuild tests suggest non-local blast radius inside a central planner path.
